subtitle: 흑석 반지 흑마 입찰과 빈 반지 칸의 진실

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
마라우돈에서 드디어 떴다!
흑석 반지는 물리 템이니
나랑 고술님 둘만 입찰이네!
cuts.visual_prompt: Medium three-quarter shot of a cute 3.5-head-ratio Korean gag webtoon dwarf hunter girl on the left, beaming with excitement as she points toward a glowing dark-stone ring resting on a small stone chest in the lower foreground. Her wooden blunderbuss gun is neatly strapped across her back while her ultra-cute chubby round baby brown bear cub wearing a forest-green neckerchief sits happily beside her boots. Minimal cave pebble touch under her feet on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
어... 잠깐만요.
캐스터인 흑마님이
왜 흑석 반지를 굴려요?
cuts.visual_prompt: Dynamic low-angle two-shot in a 3.5-head-ratio Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. On the left, the human warlock girl calmly tosses a chunky 6-sided white-and-gold cube die showing ONLY classic round dot pips (strictly ZERO digits, ZERO numbers, ZERO letters) while clutching her grumpy little red imp doll under her other arm, snagging the dark stone ring. On the right, the dwarf hunter girl freezes with wide puzzled eyes, gun kept strapped on her back. Beside Dwarf Hunter, her ultra-cute chubby round baby brown bear cub wearing a forest-green neckerchief blinks in wide-eyed confusion. Hovering smugly beside Human Warlock, her ultra-cute round squishy floating purple Voidwalker with glowing starry lavender belly and golden wrist bracers watches the dice with innocent glowing eyes.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
둘 다 대답도 없고 같은 길드네?
기즐록 가면서 혹시나 해
고술님 장비창을 봤더니...
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder perspective from behind the dwarf hunter girl in the left foreground squinting suspiciously as she peeks forward in a 3.5-head-ratio Korean gag webtoon style. Further right ahead, the troll shaman girl walks briskly away in complete silence with her wooden totems and weapons kept strapped, nervously glancing sideways over her shoulder. Minimal ground shadow beneath their boots on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Beside Dwarf Hunter's boots, her ultra-cute chubby round baby brown bear cub wearing a forest-green neckerchief squints suspiciously in the same direction.

Dramatic silent freeze-frame reaction cut in a 3.5-head-ratio Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. On the right, a close-up side view of the troll shaman girl sweating bullets in sheer panic, holding up one noticeably bare ringless hand while her other hand furtively hides a spare ring behind her back, weapons sheathed. On the left, the dwarf hunter girl stares deadpan with wide blank eyes and a slack jaw in utter disbelief. Beside Dwarf Hunter, her ultra-cute chubby round baby brown bear cub wearing a forest-green neckerchief drops its tiny jaw in deadpan disbelief.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
대놓고 반지 한 칸 비워두고
흑마님 대리 입찰 시켰네!
들키니까 슬쩍 다시 끼네?
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle comical confrontation shot in a 3.5-head-ratio Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. On the left, the exasperated dwarf hunter girl leans forward pointing an accusing finger directly at the shaman's hand, blunderbuss holstered on her back. On the right, the troll shaman girl flinches and hastily slips her original ring back onto her bare finger while avoiding eye contact and pretending innocence. Beside Dwarf Hunter, her ultra-cute chubby round baby brown bear cub wearing a forest-green neckerchief puffs its round cheeks pointing a tiny accusing paw.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
입찰 내역도 못 남겨두고
벙찐 사이에 다 나가버렸네...
다들 이런 길드 듀오 조심해요.
cuts.visual_prompt: Wide punchline shot in a 3.5-head-ratio Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. On the left, the dwarf hunter girl sits slumped dejectedly on the ground beside her sympathetic ultra-cute chubby round baby brown bear cub wearing a forest-green neckerchief and an empty loot stone, gun resting on her back. Far on the right, the human warlock girl is seen from behind casually glowing with a blue hearthstone teleport swirl as she bails out of the party without a word. Swirling alongside Human Warlock inside the blue Hearthstone teleport glow is her ultra-cute round squishy floating purple Voidwalker with glowing starry lavender belly and golden wrist bracers, waving goodbye.
